dependencies.preflight: Call loop.policy.resolve and confirm the returned Workspace id and policy hash match the intended Workspace before substantive governed work; then call a LumvaleOS status or knowledge capability and resolve standard-loop@v2. If and only if the native host returns typed status transport_closed or transport_unavailable, run the declared governed CLI MCP bridge once with the intended Workspace; never put free-form host errors in process arguments. Proceed only when its compact JSON result has ok=true; report transport=cli-mcp-bridge and degraded=true, and never record it as native MCP success. Only after the direct goal is exhausted and its scope authorises ongoing backlog work, call flow.next_due_playbook once and complete any returned lease with required evidence.
dependencies.repair: Select the intended WORKSPACE_ROOT, validate and render its agent policy, install or enable the LumvaleOS MCP for this host, and restart the agent session to restore native MCP. A verified governed CLI bridge preserves continuity but is not reconnection. Do not inherit another Workspace's standing orders or replace LumvaleOS with an ungoverned tracker-only workflow.
